(1) we propose an analytic-model based framework for predicting the execution time of queries in a dynamic concurrent workload; (2) the proposed framework can achieve competitive and often better results than the machine-learning based framework; (3) the proposed framework is more efficient than the machine-learning framework; (4) the proposed framework has a lower memory footprint; and (5) the proposed framework requires less training data

The main takeaway from our work is that
the right approach for predicting query execution time depends on the workload and the prediction task at hand.
analytic modeling can be competitive for query execution time prediction in dynamic and concurrent database workloads.
